sentences.en: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
sentences.zh: 那部关于环境危机的纪录片真是让人眼界大开。

sentences.en: Nature documentaries are often full of animals getting eaten alive.
sentences.zh: 自然类纪录片里经常有动物被活生生吃掉的画面。

sentences.en: He recorded a documentary and gave it to me.
sentences.zh: 他拍摄了一部纪录片并给了我。
